title: Galaxy device + Watch/Buds/bands bundle offer

description: Sign up for Samsung texts to receive a unique one-time code worth $20 off select Galaxy devices; September 7 through October 4, 2026.

title: Up to $250 off select Galaxy Z Fold8
description: Save up to $250 on select Galaxy Z Fold8 models, September 7 through October 5, 2026.

title: Up to $150 off select Galaxy Z Flip8
description: Save up to $150 on select Galaxy Z Flip8 models, September 28 through November 2, 2026.

title: Up to $300 off select Galaxy Z Fold8 U
description: Save up to $300 on select Galaxy Z Fold8 U models, September 28 through October 5, 2026.

title: $150 Samsung Credit with Galaxy S26 Ultra (No Trade-In)
description: Get $150 in Samsung Credit when you buy the Galaxy S26 Ultra with the 'No Trade-In' option, September 28 through October 5, 2026.

title: 25% off the featured HP PC with code FALLDEAL25
description: Take 25% off the featured HP PC advertised on the product page with code FALLDEAL25 at checkout.

title: Free storewide shipping
description: HP advertises free shipping storewide; see the product page for any exclusions.

title: Extra $30 off select Smart Tank printers with any PC
description: Get an extra $30 off select Smart Tank printers when purchased together with any PC.

title: Free shipping on orders $89+
description: Use code SHIP89 at sierra.com for free shipping on orders of $89 or more.

title: Clearance: up to 85% off
description: Sierra's clearance section advertises average savings of 55% with items up to 85% off.

title: Bulk savings on large quantities
description: Save more when you buy in bulk on eligible large-quantity purchases of building materials and supplies.

title: STOCKHOLM 2025 loveseat — 16% off, $1,249
description: STOCKHOLM 2025 loveseat is $1,249, down from $1,499 (16% off), valid September 17 through October 12, 2026.

title: Elite members: free shipping with no minimum
description: Beauty Rewards Elite members receive free shipping with no order minimum, per the program's published terms.

title: Join Beauty Rewards free
description: Join the free Beauty Rewards program to earn points on purchases and unlock member offers and tier perks.

title: No subscription needed: order meals a la carte
description: Blue Apron now offers fully a la carte ordering with no subscription required: order what you want, when you want, with no recurring commitment. Standard shipping fees apply to each non-member order.

title: Casino Tournament Access: tournament seat + drinks on us on select sailings
description: Casino tournament seat for up to 2 people plus Drinks On Us while playing in the casino for you and a companion, on select sailings. Terms apply. Offer ends November 21, 2027.

title: Seasonal member prices: book by Oct 7, 2026
description: Book by October 7, 2026 (11:59pm in property local time) for stays between September 1, 2026 and March 31, 2027. Discount applies to select properties; Member Prices are available to Expedia app users and One Key members. Limited availability, blackout periods may apply.

title: Member Prices on thousands of hotels
description: Free to join: One Key members unlock member-only hotel rates on thousands of hotels — look for the yellow price tag on eligible properties. Members also earn OneKeyCash on eligible bookings; $1 in OneKeyCash gives a $1 discount on eligible travel.

title: One Key rewards: earn OneKeyCash on bookings
description: Expedia's free travel rewards program: earn 2% in OneKeyCash for every dollar spent on eligible hotels, vacation rentals, activities, packages, car rentals and cruises, and 0.2% on eligible flights. OneKeyCash is not redeemable for cash and can only be used on Expedia, Hotels.com and Vrbo.

title: Flight + hotel package savings
description: Bundle a flight + hotel and save on participating properties with savings as marked. Per Expedia's published terms, package prices are based on the lowest price found within the past 48 hours and are subject to change; additional restrictions and blackout dates may apply.

title: App-only member prices
description: Member Prices are available to Expedia app users and One Key members. The app page notes members receive discounts on select hotels in the app, plus price tracking to know the best time to book flights.

title: Last-minute hotel deals
description: Check Expedia for member-only last-minute hotel deals to suit your budget. Browse the site and book available options; look for results marked 'Free cancellation' where flexible booking matters.

title: 50% off your first box + Free Breakfast for 1 Year
description: New subscribers get 50% off their first box plus Free Breakfast for 1 Year: 1 free breakfast item per box for 1 year while the subscription stays active. Varies by plan; new subscribers only. Factor is a HelloFresh-owned brand.

title: Free nutrition coaching sessions for subscribers
description: Factor offers free nutrition coaching sessions to subscribers, alongside access to 70+ add-ons (breakfasts, smoothies, snacks). Subscriptions can be modified, paused, skipped, or canceled anytime.

title: Free Grubhub+ membership with Amazon Prime
description: Active U.S. Amazon Prime members get the benefits of Grubhub+ with no expiration and no Grubhub+ membership fees for as long as they keep Prime: $0 delivery fees and lower service fees with instant savings shown on orders $12+, 5% back in Grubhub+ Credit on eligible pickup orders, and exclusive offers. Must link Amazon Prime and Grubhub accounts to redeem. Does not auto-convert to a paid plan if Prime is canceled. Terms and additional fees apply.

title: Grubhub+ Student: promotional membership for eligible students
description: From time to time Grubhub offers student-only promotional Grubhub+ memberships, including free or discounted trial memberships, per its official Grubhub+ Membership Terms. Eligibility, duration, and how to enroll are set by each promotional offer and determined at Grubhub's discretion. Check the Grubhub+ Membership Terms for current details.

title: Grubhub Guarantee: at least $5 off if your delivery arrives late
description: Under Grubhub's On-Time Delivery Guarantee, eligible online delivery orders that arrive late earn at least a $5 Grubhub Guarantee Perk (GHG Perk). Perks are issued for a future order (food and beverage subtotal must at least match the perk value), expire 30 days after issue, cannot be combined, and are not redeemable for cash. Claims must be submitted within the window stated in the guarantee terms.

title: Grubhub Guarantee: lowest-price match plus a $5 bonus perk
description: Under Grubhub's Lowest Price Guarantee, if you find a qualifying lower price for the same order on a competitor platform (DoorDash, Uber Eats, or Postmates only), Grubhub issues Guarantee Perks covering the price difference plus a $5 extra perk, up to a maximum $15 perk. Perks apply to a future order, expire 30 days after issue, cannot be combined, and are not redeemable for cash. Full terms at Grubhub's guarantee terms page.

title: Fall Sale: up to 30% off for members
description: Fall Sale: members save up to 30% on thousands of hotels worldwide. Available through October 7, 2026; book by October 7, 2026 (11:59pm in the hotel property's local time) for stays through March 31, 2027. Excludes taxes and fees; limited availability, blackout periods may apply.

title: VIP Access member prices on select hotels
description: Go VIP for less: save on select hotels with Member Prices. Member Prices are available to Hotels.com app users and One Key members when signed in, on selected hotels and selected dates only. VIP Access properties can carry extra perks.

title: Save Your Way: save now or bank rewards for later
description: Choose Pay Now after finalizing your room to access the Save Your Way rewards preference: at checkout, choose to save now on this trip, or bank your savings as rewards for a future trip.

title: Last-minute hotel deals
description: Last-minute hotel deals hub with discounted rates on upcoming stays. The spontaneous city breaks page advertises 20% off last-minute getaways; per its terms, offers are valid for stay dates within the next 14 days on participating properties, subject to availability.

title: BOGO60: 60% off the second guest's cruise fare (book by Oct 5)
description: 60% off the cruise fare of the second guest booked in the same stateroom as the first full-fare paying guest. Applies to new individual and named group bookings at prevailing rates made September 3-October 5, 2026, on sailings departing on or after September 4, 2026. Taxes, fees, and port expenses additional. Combinable with Kids Sail Free, Free 3rd & 4th, and instant-savings sales. Capacity controlled; subject to change without notice.

title: Kids Sail Free: kids 12 and under cruise free on select sailings (book by Oct 5)
description: Kids 12 and younger sail free (cruise fare only; taxes, fees, and port expenses additional) as additional guests in the same stateroom as two full-fare guests. Applies to new bookings made September 15-October 5, 2026, on select sailings 3 nights and longer departing on or after September 16, 2026. Excludes Thanksgiving week (Nov 19-27, 2026), Christmas/New Year (Dec 17, 2026-Jan 4, 2027), spring break (Mar 5-Apr 4, 2027), summer peak (May 28-Aug 20, 2027), and select other dates.

title: Free 3rd & 4th guests on select sailings (book by Oct 5)
description: $0 cruise fare on the 3rd and 4th guests in the same stateroom (taxes, fees, and port expenses additional). Applies to new bookings made September 15-October 5, 2026, on select sailings 3 nights and longer departing September 16, 2026-August 20, 2027. Excludes Thanksgiving week, Christmas/New Year, select Navigator of the Seas and Chinese New Year sailings, spring break, and summer peak. Combinable with BOGO60 and Kids Sail Free.

title: $100 Caribbean & West Coast kicker: instant savings up to $100 per stateroom (book by Oct 12)
description: Instant savings on all Caribbean and West Coast sailings departing September 26, 2026-April 30, 2027, booked September 25-October 12, 2026: $25 off Interior/Oceanview and Balcony staterooms and $100 off Suites on 3+ night sailings. Savings applied as an instant rebate at checkout. Combinable with BOGO60, Kids Sail Free, and Free 3rd & 4th.

title: Onboard Extras: pre-cruise savings on drinks, dining, excursions and spa
description: Pre-cruise savings on select onboard products and services booked through Plan My Cruise after confirming your sailing: beverage packages, specialty dining, shore excursions, spa services, and more. Eligible products vary. Not combinable with Crown & Anchor discounts.

title: Last Minute Cruises: discounted fares on select near-term sailings
description: Discounted pricing on select last-minute sailings listed under Last Minute Cruises in the Deals section of royalcaribbean.com. Combinable with Free 3rd & 4th guests, Kids Sail Free, Next Cruise offers, and Crown & Anchor discounts; not combinable with BOGO60 or promotional onboard credits. Capacity controlled.

title: Early Booking Bonus: $50 onboard credit when you book well ahead (by Dec 31)
description: $50 onboard credit per named booking when you book early: sailings of 5 nights or less departing 7+ months out, or 6+ nights departing 9+ months out, booked September 1-December 31, 2026. Credit split between guests 1 and 2; non-transferable, expires 10 p.m. on the final night of the cruise. Combinable with BOGO60, Kids Sail Free, and Crown & Anchor discounts.

title: Military rates: discounted fares for service members, retirees and veterans
description: Discounted military rates on select sailings for active U.S. and Canadian military personnel, retirees, and veterans with honorable discharge (2+ years of service, or 6 months in an active war zone). At least one guest per stateroom must be eligible; proof required at the pier. Select MILITARY or MILITARY NRD offer type at booking. Taxes and fees additional.

title: Resident Rates: discounted fares for residents of select states
description: Discounted Resident Rates on select sailings for residents of qualifying states (valid state of residence required at booking). Combinable with BOGO60, Kids Sail Free, Free 3rd & 4th, promotional onboard credits, instant savings, and promo-code offers; not combinable with Senior, Military, or Shareholder discounts. Capacity controlled.

title: Senior Rates: discounted fares for senior travelers
description: Discounted Senior Rates on select sailings for senior travelers. Combinable with BOGO60, Kids Sail Free, Free 3rd & 4th guests, promotional onboard credits, Next Cruise offers, instant savings, promo-code offers, Crown & Anchor discounts, and Shareholder Benefits. Capacity controlled.

title: Hertz: save on Pay Later rates + earn up to 2,750 Rapid Rewards points
description: Save on Hertz Pay Later base rates and earn Rapid Rewards points on qualifying rentals: 1-2 days earn 600 points, 3-6 days earn 1,200 points, 7+ days earn 2,750 points. Provide promo code 212250 with CDP 2320510 and your Rapid Rewards number at time of reservation. Reservations must be made by December 31, 2026 for vehicle pick-up on or before December 31, 2026. Participating Hertz locations in the U.S., Mexico, Canada, and Puerto Rico. Cannot be combined with other promotions. Bonus points do not count toward A-List, A-List Preferred, or Companion Pass qualification.

title: Dollar: save up to 15% on car rentals + earn up to 1,200 Rapid Rewards points
description: Save up to 15% on Dollar Pay Later base rates and earn Rapid Rewards points: 1-2 days earn 600 points, 3+ days earn 1,200 points. Provide promo code 102444 with Corporate Discount Code 3021001 and your Rapid Rewards number at time of reservation. Valid for vehicle pick-up on or before December 31, 2026. Cannot be combined with other discounts or promotions. Bonus points do not count toward A-List, A-List Preferred, or Companion Pass qualification.

title: Avis: earn up to 2,400 Rapid Rewards points + save up to 35%
description: Earn up to 2,400 Rapid Rewards points on qualifying Avis car rentals and save up to 35% off base rates. Valid through January 31, 2027. Terms apply.

title: Budget: earn up to 3,000 Rapid Rewards points + save up to 30%
description: Earn up to 3,000 Rapid Rewards points on qualifying Budget car rentals and save up to 30% off base rates. Valid through January 31, 2027. Terms apply.

title: Payless: earn up to 1,200 Rapid Rewards points + save 10%
description: Earn up to 1,200 Rapid Rewards points on qualifying Payless car rentals and save 10% on base rates in the U.S. and Canada. Valid through January 31, 2027. Terms apply.

title: Thrifty: earn up to 1,200 Rapid Rewards points + save up to 10%
description: Earn up to 1,200 Rapid Rewards points on qualifying Thrifty car rentals and save up to 10% on base rates. Terms apply. Standing promotion listed on Southwest's Rapid Rewards promotions hub.

title: Laithwaites: 2,000 bonus Rapid Rewards points with $79.99 intro wine case
description: Introductory wine club case from Laithwaites: 12 wines for $79.99 (plus shipping and tax) with 2,000 Rapid Rewards bonus points, 2 bonus bottles, and 2 Dartington Crystal stemless glasses. Earn 1,000 points on each future club case and 3 points per $1 on non-club purchases. Standing offer on southwest.com.

title: Rapid Rewards Dining: earn up to 500 bonus points when you join
description: Join Rapid Rewards Dining and earn up to 500 bonus points: earn 3 points per dollar at participating restaurants (while opted in to emails), plus a 500-point first-step bonus after earning your first 1,500 points through dines and reviews, then 300 bonus points for every subsequent 1,000 points. Register a credit or debit card and points transfer automatically.

title: Southwest Hotels: earn up to 10,000 Rapid Rewards points per night
description: Earn up to 10,000 Rapid Rewards points per night on qualifying hotel stays booked through Southwest Hotels. Featured promotion on southwest.com's Rapid Rewards promotions hub.

title: Refer a Friend: 20,000 points per friend who gets a Rapid Rewards card (up to 100,000)
description: Earn 20,000 Rapid Rewards points for each friend who gets any Rapid Rewards Credit Card, up to 100,000 points. Refer through southwest.com's Refer a Friend page. Terms apply.

title: Reliant: up to 27,000 Rapid Rewards bonus points for signing up for Secure 24 (TX)
description: Earn up to 27,000 Rapid Rewards bonus points when you sign up for the Reliant Secure 24 electricity plan. Valid for select ZIP codes in Texas. Terms apply.

title: Rewards for Opinions: 500 bonus points for signing up and completing your first survey
description: Earn 500 bonus Rapid Rewards points when you sign up for Rewards for Opinions and complete your first survey within 3 months of enrolling, plus more points for every survey you take. Terms apply.

title: Rapid Rewards Shopping: earn points at 1,100+ online stores
description: Earn Rapid Rewards points shopping at 1,100+ online stores through Rapid Rewards Shopping. Earn rates vary by retailer. Standing program listed on southwest.com.

title: Latest Deals: rotating restaurant deals in the app
description: Uber Eats' official deals hub for rotating discounts, restaurant rewards, and savings exclusive to Uber Eats. Offers change regularly and vary by location and availability. Taxes and other fees still apply; valid at participating restaurants only; cannot be combined. See the app for current details and availability.

title: Last-minute booking discounts on vacation homes
description: Search your destination, add travel dates within the next 30 days, then apply the 'Last minute booking' filter to find vacation homes with a last-minute discount.

title: Discounts on newly listed rentals
description: A discount is available for a limited time on select newly listed vacation rentals. Availability varies by property.

description: Select homes offer a weekly discount for stays of 7+ nights, with average savings of $213 per Vrbo. To find them, select the 'Weekly discount' filter on the search results page and set travel dates of 7+ nights to see prices and savings.

title: Monthly-stay discounts (28+ nights)

title: Use OneKeyCash on private vacation rentals
description: Redeem your OneKeyCash on an eligible Vrbo stay: sign in, search for a vacation home, select your dates, and choose 'Apply OneKeyCash' when booking if the option is available. OneKeyCash is not redeemable for cash and can only be used on Vrbo, Expedia and Hotels.com.

title: BOGO 25% Off Select Air Care Items
description: Buy one, get one 25% off select air care items. Shown on Target's homepage today; exclusions apply. No code needed.

description: Get a $10 Target gift card when you buy 2 Swiffer items. Shown on Target's homepage today; exclusions apply.

description: Trade in your old car seat and get a 20% off bonus on a new baby gear purchase. Event runs 9/20-10/3 per Target's homepage today; exclusions apply.

title: BOGO 25% Off Select Skin Care Products
description: Buy one, get one 25% off select skin care products. Shown on Target's homepage today; exclusions apply. No code needed.

title: Up to 50% Off Home Items In Store + More Online Deals
description: Up to 50% off home items in store plus more online deals, shown on Target's homepage today. Items vary by location; exclusions apply.

title: DashPass Free for 30 Days + $0 Delivery Fees
description: DashPass free for 30 days for new members. Members get a $0 delivery fee on DashPass orders and 5% back on pickup orders. Shown on doordash.com homepage today.
